meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein acne wali skin ke liye **₹700 ke andar** kai behtareen serums available hain. Agar aapko active acne, pimples, ya blackheads ki problem hai, toh **2% Salicylic Acid (BHA)** ya **Niacinamide** ingredients wale serums sabse acche maane jaate hain.

₹700 ki range mein kuch top-rated options yeh rahe:

Yeh Minimalist Salicylic Acid Face Serum deep pores ko saaf Karke acne aur blackheads ko control karta hai.

Yeh Chemist at Play 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum Treats Acne salicylic acid ke sath zinc PCA aur ceramides provide karta hai jo skin ko bina dry kiye acne theek karte hain.

Yeh Dot & Key 2% Salicylic Cica Anti Acne Serum cica aur salicylic acid ke blend se active acne aur redness ko soothing relief deta hai.

Yeh The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Serum for Active Acne oil control karne aur clogged pores ko kholne ke liye ek popular aur effective option hai.
